text:
Maria Chen: Changelog cutoff in ~4h — quick sync. Which sample apps + SDK changelog lines must land by EOD? Drop PR links. @Kevin, @Jamal, @Lia?

Kevin Patel: I’m green on the SDK changes but blocked by a flaky Windows CI job. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/482 — aiming to merge after CI passes (~2pm PT).

Jamal Ortiz: sample-apps status: 
- chatbot-embed: small README fix pending (PR #179)
- sync-demo: had a deps bump, I pushed a follow-up (PR #184)
I can squash if that helps merge faster.

Lia (docs): Docs needs a one-line changelog bullet + localized strings (FR/DE). I can draft the entry if PRs land by 1:30pm. Also need final screenshots from the sample apps.

Maria Chen: Can someone paste a short changelog snippet here (one-liners, single bullet each). Example format below — copy/paste into each PR: 

```
- devex: SDK v1.4.2 — fix streaming edgecase with long prompts (#482) — @kevin
- devex: sample-apps — add embedding demo and README fixes (#179) — @jamal
```

Kevin Patel: Added the SDK snippet to PR #482 and kicked CI rerun. PTAL @maria.

DevEx Bot: Reminder — changelog cutoff in ~2h. CI must be green for merges. :alarm_clock:

Priya Shah (QA): Quick smoke scheduled at 3:00pm PT for sync-demo and chatbot-embed. I’ll post results here.

Jamal Ortiz: QA acked — smoke passed with one minor UI wording fix, pushed in PR #184. PR #179 is merge-ready.

Lia (docs): Uploaded screenshots to /assets/quickstart/embedding and started FR/DE drafts. FR reviewer needed for a 10-min pass.

Maria Chen: Ownership summary: Kevin — SDK merge; Jamal — sample-apps + ensure PRs; Lia — changelog + localized docs/screenshots; Priya — QA smoke. If any blocker, ping me directly. If not merged by cutoff we’ll defer to the next release window. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Kevin Patel: On it. If Windows CI fails again I’ll revert flaky test and open follow-up.

Priya Shah (QA): Smoke passed, no blocking regressions.

Lia (docs): FR check done (small typo fixed). Ready to publish changelog.

Maria Chen: Thanks all — finalizing. I’ll update the release tracker and close the cutoff item. :tada:
